description: This file defines the 'Meeting' class, representing a meeting entity within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for meeting details, methods for managing meeting data, relationships with users, contacts, and leads, and functions for handling notifications, API integrations, and export queries. The class extends SugarBean and integrates with SuiteCRM's core architecture, managing CRUD operations, access control, and related data.

classes.name: Meeting
classes.description: Represents a scheduled meeting with properties and methods to manage its lifecycle, relationships, notifications, and integrations within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Meeting object, setting up custom fields and default values.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to perform certain actions on the Meeting, especially handling recurrences from external sources.

methods.name: hasIntegratedMeeting
methods.description: Stub for API integration; currently returns false.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the meeting record, updating date fields, handling API integrations, notifications, and reminders.

methods.name: removeUnInvitedFromReminders
methods.description: Filters out invitees from reminders who are no longer associated with the meeting.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks a meeting as deleted and updates related calendars.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the meeting as a summary.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to export meeting data, optionally including contact information.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional related data such as owner names and contact details.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list views, including formatting and status indicators.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Creates the notification email body with meeting details for recipients.

methods.name: create_notification_email
methods.description: Generates an email notification with calendar invite attachment.

methods.name: send_assignment_notifications
methods.description: Removes calendar invite files after notifications are sent.

methods.name: get_meeting_users
methods.description: Retrieves users linked to the meeting.

methods.name: get_invite_meetings
methods.description: Gets meetings that a specific user is invited to.

methods.name: set_accept_status
methods.description: Updates the acceptance status for a user, contact, or lead related to the meeting.

methods.name: get_notification_recipients
methods.description: Compiles and returns the list of users, contacts, and leads to notify about the meeting.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a certain interface; here, 'ACL'.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides ACL-based permissions for list view fields.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves related records, excluding certain fields based on context.

methods.name: afterImportSave
methods.description: Handles relationship linkage after importing records, e.g., linking contacts or leads.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns the default status for a new meeting.
